title: WmsBusinessTypes
description: Shared WMS business-domain vocabulary. Owned by the WMS/recipient team — NOT the firewall. Declares reusable primitives and composites used across multiple payload schemas. Changing a type here (e.g. extending MaterialNumber length) is a business/master-data decision and never touches the firewall schema.

SapItemNumber.description: SAP 5-digit zero-padded document line-item number (DOCUMENT_ITEM_SAP). Increments by 10: 00010, 00020, 00030.

StorageLocation.description: SAP 4-character storage location code. Uppercase alphanumeric.

MaterialNumber.description: SAP material number. Numeric in standard systems; may contain uppercase and hyphens in extended configurations.

WmsOrderType.description: WMS order type code (WMS_ORD_TP). Determines which DOC_HEADER payload schema branch fires in Layer 2. 101=inbound transfer, 201=outbound transfer, 301=inventory adjustment, 401=vendor return, 501=cross-dock. Extend this enum when new order types are onboarded — requires only a business-types update, not a firewall change.

SapDocumentType.description: SAP document type code. Uppercase alphanumeric, 2–4 chars. Custom types begin with 'Z'.

TwoDigitCode.description: Generic 2-digit numeric code. Used for CUSTOMER_TYPE, DELIVERY_PRIORITY, SHIP_CON and similar SAP code fields.

SapQuantity.description: SAP quantity as a decimal string with exactly 3 decimal places, as transmitted in IDocs and WMS interfaces.

CoordinateDecimal.description: Geographic coordinate as a decimal string with exactly 12 decimal places. Zero value is '0.000000000000'.

SerialNumber.description: Equipment/serial number. Uppercase alphanumeric with hyphens. Used in SERIAL_NUMBERS arrays for serial-number managed materials.

WeightDecimal.description: Weight value with exactly 3 decimal places (kg by default unless WEIGHT_UNIT is set).

LinearDimension.description: Linear dimension (length/width/height) with exactly 2 decimal places.

HuType.description: Handling unit type. PAL=euro pallet, BOX=carton box, BAG=bulk bag, CTN=ISO container, PLT=flat pallet, TRL=trailer load.

DimensionUnit.description: Unit of measure for linear dimensions used in HU DIMENSIONS objects.

WeightUnit.description: Unit of measure for weight fields (GROSS_WEIGHT, TARE_WEIGHT).

QualityDecision.description: Quality usage decision code attached to an inspection lot. A=Accept (unrestricted stock), R=Reject (returns to vendor or scrap), P=Partial accept (split stock), N=Not yet decided (inspection still open).

InspectionCharResult.description: Result of evaluating a single quality inspection characteristic. NA=not applicable for this material, PENDING=awaiting lab result.

SapAdjustmentQuantity.description: Signed SAP quantity for inventory adjustments. Positive = stock increase, negative = stock decrease. Same 3-decimal-place format as SapQuantity but permits a leading minus sign.

AdjustmentReason.description: Reason code for an inventory adjustment line (WMS_ORD_TP=301). Required on every adjustment item.

HuDimensions.description: Physical outer dimensions of a handling unit. All values in the unit specified by UNIT field.

HuItem.description: A single material line packed inside a handling unit. Represents the physical packing detail — what material, which batch, how many, and optionally the serial number.

SERIAL_NUMBER.$comment: Optional. Non-empty only for serial-number managed materials.

HandlingUnit.description: A physical handling unit (pallet, box, container) assigned to a document item. Demonstrates three levels of nesting: HandlingUnit → DIMENSIONS (nested object) + ITEMS (array of HuItem dicts).

HU_NUMBER.description: SAP HU number. 18–20 digit SSCC-format barcode printed on the label.

ITEMS.description: Materials packed inside this HU. Each entry is an HuItem dict (MATERIAL, BATCH, QUANTITY, SERIAL_NUMBER).

BatchSplit.description: A portion of a line item fulfilled from one specific batch. Used when a single delivery line is split across multiple batches (e.g. partial FIFO fulfilment).

SHELF_LIFE_EXP_DATE.$comment: Best-before/expiry date. Optional — blank for non-perishables. Non-empty must be a valid SapDate (YYYYMMDD).

InspectionCharacteristic.description: A single quality characteristic evaluated during goods receipt inspection. Attribute checks (visual, label) use RESULT only; quantitative checks (weight, temperature) also carry NUMERIC_VALUE and LOWER/UPPER limits.

CHAR_NAME.description: SAP inspection characteristic name (e.g. LABEL_CHECK, NET_WEIGHT, TEMP_STORAGE).

NUMERIC_VALUE.$comment: Measured value for quantitative characteristics. Blank for attribute (pass/fail only) characteristics.

UNIT.description: Unit of measure for NUMERIC_VALUE (e.g. KG, C, MM). Blank for attribute characteristics.

LOWER_LIMIT.description: Minimum acceptable value for quantitative characteristics.

UPPER_LIMIT.description: Maximum acceptable value for quantitative characteristics.

QualityInspection.description: Quality inspection block attached to a document item. Present only for Q-inspection managed materials. Contains the inspection lot reference, usage decision, and an array of evaluated characteristics (each an InspectionCharacteristic dict).

INSPECTION_LOT.description: 12-digit SAP inspection lot number assigned at goods receipt.

INSPECTOR_ID.description: SAP user ID of the inspector who posted the usage decision.

CHARACTERISTICS.description: Array of quality characteristics evaluated during inspection. Each entry is an InspectionCharacteristic dict.

DocItem.description: A single WMS document line item. Open schema (no additionalProperties:false) — SAP custom Z-fields and extension fields are common and must not be rejected by schema drift. Nested fields: BATCH_SPLITS (array of dicts), HANDLING_UNITS (array of dicts with nested DIMENSIONS + ITEMS), QUALITY_INSPECTION (object with CHARACTERISTICS array), SERIAL_NUMBERS (array of strings), CUSTOM_FIELDS (dict).

TRANSIT_DOCKING_PLANT.$comment: Optional. Empty string = no transit plant (direct shipment). Non-empty must satisfy PlantCode pattern.

SERIAL_NUMBERS.description: Array of serial numbers for serial-number managed materials. Length must not exceed QUANTITY. Omit entirely for non-serialized materials.
SERIAL_NUMBERS.$comment: ARRAY OF STRINGS — one per physical unit. Uniqueness enforced: same serial cannot appear twice on the same line item.

BATCH_SPLITS.description: Array of batch split dicts. Present when a single line item is fulfilled from multiple batches. Sum of quantities across splits should equal item QUANTITY. Each split is a BatchSplit object: { BATCH, QUANTITY, STOCK_TYPE?, STORAGE_LOCATION?, SHELF_LIFE_EXP_DATE? }.
BATCH_SPLITS.$comment: ARRAY OF DICTS — minItems:2 because a single-batch item uses the flat BATCH field instead.

HANDLING_UNITS.description: Array of handling unit dicts describing the physical packaging of this line item. Each HandlingUnit has: HU_NUMBER, HU_TYPE, weights, DIMENSIONS (nested object: LENGTH/WIDTH/HEIGHT/UNIT), and ITEMS (nested array of HuItem dicts: MATERIAL/BATCH/QUANTITY/SERIAL_NUMBER).
HANDLING_UNITS.$comment: ARRAY OF DICTS WITH NESTED OBJECT + ARRAY — three-level nesting: DocItem → HandlingUnit → HuDimensions (dict) + HuItem[] (array of dicts).

QUALITY_INSPECTION.$comment: NESTED OBJECT WITH ARRAY INSIDE — present only for Q-managed materials. Contains INSPECTION_LOT, USAGE_DECISION, INSPECTION_DATE, INSPECTOR_ID, and CHARACTERISTICS (array of InspectionCharacteristic dicts each with CHAR_NAME, RESULT, NUMERIC_VALUE, UNIT, LOWER/UPPER_LIMIT).

CUSTOM_FIELDS.description: Arbitrary SAP Z-field extension bag. Keys are field names (convention: ZCUSTOM_*), values are raw SAP string values. Open dict — no fixed property list. Allows any implementation-specific Z-fields without a schema update.
CUSTOM_FIELDS.$comment: DICT (string → string) — models SAP's customer-namespace Z-field pattern. Example: { 'ZCUSTOM_PRIO': 'HIGH', 'ZCUSTOM_ZONE': 'COLD_CHAIN' }.

DocItem.$comment: Open schema (no additionalProperties:false) — SAP custom Z-fields added by the implementation team must not cause a firewall schema update. New nested structures (SERIAL_NUMBERS, BATCH_SPLITS, HANDLING_UNITS, QUALITY_INSPECTION, CUSTOM_FIELDS) are all optional extras.

UsageDecisionBlock.description: Quality usage decision block. Encapsulates the final SAP usage decision for an inspection lot: decision code, inspector, date, and optional remarks. Promoted from per-interface inline definition to BT so all schemas share one canonical type.

DECISION.description: Decision code: A=Accept, R=Reject, P=Partial, N=Not yet decided.

INSPECTOR_ID.description: SAP user ID of the inspector who posted the usage decision.

InterfaceName.description: SAP WMS interface routing key. Always begins with 'Z' (custom namespace), uppercase alphanumeric + underscore. Strictly pattern-checked — unknown interfaces are hard-rejected. Analogous to message_type in the generic firewall.

MessageId.description: Unique 16-digit zero-padded message identifier assigned by the sending system.

PlantCode.description: SAP 4-digit numeric plant code. Infrastructure primitive — owned by the infra/master-data team. Declared once here; $ref'd by any payload field that carries a plant code (SUPPLYING_PLANT, RECEIVING_PLANT, TRANSIT_DOCKING_PLANT).

ConsigneeCode.description: Recipient/consignee short code. Uppercase alphanumeric, 2–10 chars. Infrastructure-level recipient identity — not a business-domain customer identifier.

SapDate.description: SAP compact date format YYYYMMDD. Used for all date fields across envelope and payload. Declared once here; $ref'd by payload date fields (DELIVERY_DATE etc.).

SapTime.description: SAP compact time format HHMMSS (24-hour). Used in envelope timestamp; payload systems may $ref for time fields.

OpaqueDocHeader.description: Business document payload. INTENTIONALLY OPAQUE to the firewall. Structure varies by WMS_ORD_TP order type. The recipient/WMS system is the sole owner of DOC_HEADER validation (Layer 2).
